name: month_successor
description: Name the month that comes N (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same format but asks to repeat the given month (copy), so no calendar arithmetic is needed.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"]
def make(ctrl,n=120):
    out=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        shots=[(random.randrange(12),random.randint(1,3)) for _ in range(3)]
        m,k=random.randrange(12),random.randint(1,3)
        if ctrl:
            p="".join(f"{k2} months after {M[m2]}, repeat: {M[m2]}\n" for m2,k2 in shots)+f"{k} months after {M[m]}, repeat:"
            a=" "+M[m]
        else:
            p="".join(f"{k2} months after {M[m2]} is {M[(m2+k2)%12]}\n" for m2,k2 in shots)+f"{k} months after {M[m]} is"
            a=" "+M[(m+k)%12]
        out.append({"prompt":p,"answer":a})
    return out
json.dump({"items":make(False),"control":make(True)},open("/work/skill.json","w"))
